from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
ROOT=Path.cwd()
OUT=ROOT/"reports/research/510300_monthly_account_target_gap_diagnostic_v1"
assert not OUT.exists(),"E18目录已存在，先核已有状态，不能覆盖。"
OUT.mkdir()
def receipt(name):
    path=ROOT/name;data=path.read_bytes()
    return {"path":name,"bytes":len(data),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}
sources=[
"reports/research/510300_corporate_loan_weighted_rate_source_qualification_v1/result.json",
"reports/research/510300_corporate_loan_weighted_rate_source_qualification_v1/next_experiment.json",
"reports/research/510300_factor96_bottleneck_diagnostic_v1/protocol.json",
"reports/research/510300_factor96_bottleneck_diagnostic_v1/result.json",
"reports/research/510300_multidim_shared_evidence_attribution_v1/protocol.json",
"reports/research/510300_multidim_shared_evidence_attribution_v1/result.json",
"reports/research/510300_multidim_money_surprise_score_v1/account_protocol.json",
"reports/research/510300_multidim_money_surprise_score_v1/account_result.json",
"reports/research/510300_multidim_money_surprise_score_v1/全部账户自然交易周期.csv",
"reports/research/510300_multidim_money_surprise_score_v1/完整账户指标.csv",
"reports/research/510300_multidim_financing_composition_v1/data_correction/monthly_score/protocol.json",
"reports/research/510300_multidim_financing_composition_v1/data_correction/monthly_score/全部固定高分机会.csv"
]
cases=["state_200000","state_20000","joint_200000","joint_20000"]
sources += ["reports/research/510300_multidim_money_surprise_score_v1/accounts/"+ident+".parquet" for ident in cases]
receipts=[receipt(name) for name in sources]
prior={
    "reviewed_at":datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat(),
    "prior_factor96":"49固定压力账本/245成本约束反事实，范围为9月旧规则；不是10月1日登记的M2月度完整账户。",
    "prior_E1":"三评分共享叶/窗口及实际持有重合、收益集中；没有机会密度、半仓等幅目标情景和原账户费用返还的同口径缺口表。",
    "limited_novelty":"这里只核最接近两项旧用途及当前文档，不宣称全仓从未计算过。",
    "overlap_accepted":"保留费用归因方法和旧瓶颈，不重复旧49反事实，不改变M2信号或账户。",
    "prior_observed":"M2主期夏普1.241554、年化约1.9976%、2024三笔/2025两笔、最大笔占82.263%已知；本诊断不是独立验证。",
    "new_model_or_strategy_admitted":False
}
protocol={
    "study_id":"510300_MONTHLY_ACCOUNT_TARGET_GAP_DIAGNOSTIC_V1","experiment_id":"E18",
    "registered_at":datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat(),
    "phase":"SAVED_FIXED_HOLDINGS_TARGET_GAP_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY",
    "hypothesis":"原M2完整账户的低年化首先受已观察机会数量及每笔全账户收益制约，而非仅手续费。用保存账本精确区分，不预设下一信号。",
    "input_scope":"同四个原state/joint、20万/2万元完整账户；原六种情况中的现金及50%买入持有只保留旧描述，不提升为候选。",
    "cases":cases,
    "periods":[{"name":"完整期2021—2025","start":"2021-01-01","end":"2025-12-31"},
               {"name":"较早期2021—2023","start":"2021-01-01","end":"2023-12-31"},
               {"name":"主要期2024—2025","start":"2024-01-01","end":"2025-12-31"}],
    "fixed_sources_before_diagnostic":receipts,
    "operations":[
        "从原equity/net_return精确恢复原完整分段净收益、242日CAGR和净夏普，对照保存指标。",
        "只用原自然完成周期，按入场年计数；用profit/start_equity的乘积恢复净值，所有零次年份和亏损保留。",
        "原ledger同现金日/同份额/同成交动作下逐日返还commission+slippage_cost，计算固定持仓解释路径，不重新下单或改变风险/现金/权益。",
        "记录平均市值仓位、持仓收盘天数、无市值持仓比例、入场实际名义金额/原NAV。",
        "只计算固定10%年化、每年5等幅交易、每笔50%仓位/零费用/无减仓的情景算术；另按原段交易次数计算等幅NAV所需幅度。情景不是统计预测或可执行账户。"
    ],
    "actual_cost_definition":"原ledger佣金及压力成交价相对开盘的slippage_cost；tick取整已在实际价差内。不从理论费率重复扣。",
    "refund_path_definition":"原全期equity加原费用累计；每个分段基准取该解释路径原前一收盘，不重置资金/份额。terminal_exit_reserve为0才运行当前简化，若非0则停止并另留实现修订。",
    "cycle_checks":"各分段起止无股票持仓；周期闭合且无跨段；净周期乘积等于保存NAV，持有中净值可波动。若不满足，不裁切/删周期。",
    "no_strategy_parameter_choices":True,"signal_score_line":80,"holding_sessions":5,
    "account_targets":{"net_sharpe":1.2,"net_cagr":0.1,"max_drawdown":0.1,"minimum_cycles_each_full_year":5},
    "annual_days":242,"maximum_position_fraction":0.5,
    "not_executable":"费用返还忽略已改变权益对风险动作的影响；每年5笔理想情景不提供交易信号，不能晋升或选择为新账户。",
    "minimum_checks":["16冻结输入身份不变","12原指标行与日账本一致","全周期利润/费用与日账本一致","原次数和现金日未改"],
    "new_equity_labels":0,"new_fits":0,"new_engine_accounts":0,"new_repository_source_code_edits":0,
    "parameter_searches":0,"orders_authorized":False,"new_prospective_forecasts_enabled":False,
    "current_view":"NO_VIEW","position":"UNSET","goal_achieved":False,"independent_validation":False
}
for name,value in [("prior_definition_review.json",prior),("protocol.json",protocol),("source_parent_hashes.json",receipts)]:
    (OUT/name).write_text(json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
freeze={"registered_at":protocol["registered_at"],"before_new_E18_diagnostic_computations":True,
        "before_new_E18_models":True,"protocol_sha256":hashlib.sha256((OUT/"protocol.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "source_parent_hashes_sha256":hashlib.sha256((OUT/"source_parent_hashes.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
(OUT/"source_freeze.json").write_text(json.dumps(freeze,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print("E18仅保存账本诊断已登记：四原账户、三固定时期；16来源冻结。")
print("不改信号/持有/风险，0新模型/账户/源码改动。")
